documents.title: Acute STEMI management
documents.text: Acute myocardial infarction and STEMI management includes immediate reperfusion, aspirin, antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation, nitrates when appropriate, and guideline-directed secondary prevention after acute coronary syndrome.

documents.title: Pulmonary embolism diagnostic workup
documents.text: Pulmonary embolism workup uses pretest probability. High pretest probability should proceed to CT pulmonary angiography when possible, while low probability can use D-dimer strategies.

documents.title: Dangerous chest pain differential
documents.text: Acute coronary syndrome, pulmonary embolism, and aortic dissection are high-risk causes of chest pain. Distinguish them by risk factors, exam, ECG, imaging, and hemodynamic instability.

documents.title: Diabetes complication edge
documents.text: Diabetes mellitus COMPLICATES diabetic nephropathy, neuropathy, retinopathy, and cardiovascular disease.
